final: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(1.0 * HGB / HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0 GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_ratios), first_kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, o.avg_ratio FROM patient_ratios p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio), second_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM first_kept), final_kept AS (SELECT f.ratio, f.ratio - f.avg_ratio AS above_overall, f.ratio - s.avg_ratio AS above_second FROM first_kept f CROSS JOIN second_avg s WHERE f.ratio > s.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(above_overall) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(above_second) AS avg_above_second FROM final_kept
